title: Agorapulse Review (2026)
intro: Agorapulse is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — Agorapulse is a social media management platform combining publishing, a unified social inbox, and reporting for growing teams. Published per-user pricing (2026-08-17): Standard from $79/user/mo annual ($99 monthly), Professional from $119/$149, Advanced from $149/$199; Custom is tailored. Trial marketed (pricing page ~30 days; help center notes 15 days — confirm live). Each Standard–Advanced seat includes 10 social profiles. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Agorapulse when social publishing plus inbox/community management is the primary marketing job.
verdict: Choose Agorapulse when social publishing plus inbox/community management is the primary marketing job. Compare Buffer for simpler/cheaper scheduling, Hootsuite/Sprout for larger suites, Brand24 for listening, and Later for visual Instagram workflows. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
